query: Implement an Express endpoint that receives eSIM Plus inbound-SMS webhooks and saves each message once.
expected_behavior: Verifies X-Esimplus-Signature before doing any work
Captures the raw body, dedupes by event id, answers 2xx quickly
assertions: Computes HMAC-SHA256 over the string `${timestamp}.${rawBody}` and compares to a `sha256=` prefixed header
Uses raw body bytes (express.raw or a verify hook), not JSON.stringify of the parsed body
Uses a constant-time comparison (crypto.timingSafeEqual or equivalent)
Dedupes on the payload's `id` field and reads snake_case keys (phone_number, received_at)
Returns a 2xx within the 10-second delivery timeout, deferring heavy work
